verdict.rationale: The UI offers many filing and account functions: entity formation, name reservation, periodic reports, trademarks, certificates of good standing, and prepaid accounts. None of them has a documented programmatic API. The only verified API is a keyless, read-only business-entities dataset on the state's Socrata open-data platform (data.colorado.gov), which the probe notes is served from that platform rather than the registry itself. A read-only data mirror on a separate host platform does not give API parity with the registry's UI.
